baselines.description: Per-node isolated SQLite session store: each gunicorn worker uses isolated temp DB file /tmp/spider-pernode-<worker>.db (simulating per-node WAL not shared). Real HTTP via nginx round-robin. Expected to replicate prior distributed failure: session_status TN=0.0 on round-robin, mean TN~0.667 (<0.85), n_non304 nominal but TN fails. Serves as strong negative baseline proving failure is replication not algorithm. Must use real requests, not synthetic.

Shared-store fix: single SQLite WAL file at /tmp/spider-runtime-35860330078/shared.db (WAL mode, shared across both gunicorn workers, check_same_thread=False). Both workers connect to same file. Real HTTP via nginx round-robin, real If-None-Match/ETag->304, per-batch SELECT COMMIT verification logged. Expected TN>=0.85, n_non304>=800, stratified r within 0.15, X-Worker-Pid >=10 per worker. Primary intervention for H1.

Sticky-session fix (exploratory): per-node DB files but nginx ip_hash (hash $remote_addr consistent) sticky routing ensures same client IP hits same worker >90%. Real HTTP with real client IPs (not simulated skew). Expected TN>=0.85 as alternative to shared store if ip_hash works, reported separately with per-worker distribution skewed. Tests OR clause of mandate.

Fingerprint = hash(status) only. Expected 0.0 on 200 vs 200 body-only and header-only via direct and via Playwright browser fetch (proves status confound removed). Stable ID reused for AUDIT recomputation.

Fingerprint = hash(decompressed body_bytes SHA256) only. Expected 1.0 deterministically on body-only AvsC (31B vs 117B 86B diff) AvsB (70B vs31B 39B) and gradient 1B/2B/4B diffs (32vs31,33vs31,35vs31) via direct and via browser decompressed bodies, 0.0 on header-only AvsE (bodies identical 31B). Proves body signal when status constant.

Filtered headers including Content-Length. Expected via direct+BrowserGym: body-only 1.0 solely via CLEN (31 vs32/33/35/70/117) with headers-no-CLEN 0.0, header-only 1.0 via CC/ETag/SC/Vary with bodies identical 31B. Isolates body-correlated vs independent header signal for gradient ordering. Must be real browser fetches for browser arm.

Filtered headers minus Content-Length. Expected 0.0 on body-only AvsC/AvsB/gradients (no independent header drift), 1.0 on header-only AvsE and per-header isolations CC_small/large, ETag_small/large, SC_small/large, Vary_small when fetched via browser or direct. Critical isolation for sensitivity ordering (Cache-Control vs ETag vs Vary).

decision_rule: SUPPORTS (both substrates close block) requires ALL mandatory conditions with validity checks passing and NO synthetic data: (C1-FRESHNESS) shared-store (or sticky) arm mean TN>=0.85 across session_status/profile/data_list (each Wilson 95% lower>0.75, session_status individually >=0.85) AND per-node baseline TN mean<0.85 (replicates 0.667 failure, proves fix not tautological) measured via real nginx round-robin with 4-concurrency SEED 44; (C2-FRESHNESS) n_non304>=800 after real 304 exclusion (counted from raw_freshness_observations.jsonl where is_304==false via If-None-Match/ETag, stratified across 3 endpoints); (C3-FRESHNESS) stratified pooled Pearson r equivalence TOST within delta=0.15 (95% Fisher z CI upper<0.15 AND TOST p_upper<0.05, CI lower>-0.15, pooled |r|<0.15) on shared-store arm with 8/8 conditions variance std>0 and noise FP<=0.15 (C4); (C5-BROWSER-PROVISION) agentlab 0.4.2 importable (0.14.3 correctly absent) Playwright viewport 1280x720 verified, CDP AX nodes>10 median on /resource pages and PC-HEALTH>=80% and DOM enumeration 21-82 on each /resource page where measured via real Playwright; (C6-BROWSER-DISCRIMINATION) browser body-only AvsC full>0.5 expect 1.0 with status 0.0 headers-no-CLEN 0.0 and browser header-only AvsE full>0.5 headers-only 1.0 status 0.0 body 0.0 CLEN 31==31 via Playwright fetch to /resource (direct sanity also 1.0). Gradient reporting mandatory G1_BODY (32B 1B,33B 2B,35B 4B,70B 39B,117B 86B) and G2_HEADER (CC_small 3601 1s, CC_large 0, ETag_small 1char, ETag_large changed, SC_small, SC_large, Vary_small) each with full/body/headers/headers-no-CLEN Jaccard and CI [lo,hi] width degenerate effective_distinct_n via both direct and browser — must be present with disclosure even if all 1.0 degenerate (ordering then unknown but not gating SUPPORTS). If any C1-C6 fails where validity passes => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING bounded to failing branch (distributed vs browser). If shared-store and sticky both fail where per-node correctly fails => FALSIFIED for distributed replication. If browser provision fails but distributed passes => MIXED (distributed SUPPORTS browser MEASUREMENT_INVALID/FALSIFIED). If C2 power fails (<800) with C1/C3 passing => MEASUREMENT_INVALID underpowered not falsification. Any synthetic harness or relabeled browser_fetch triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per frozen falsifier, not SUPPORTS. Infrastructure-unavailable branches map to MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification; paid CDN absent explicitly NOT gating.

Graph can now proceed to distributed delta-repair and freshness guards on 2-node gunicorn+nginx with trusted shared store. (2) BrowserGym/AgentLab 0.4.2 + Playwright 1280x720 with CDP AX>10 median PC-HEALTH>=80% DOM 21-82 on /resource pages provisions live browser observation substrate where HTTP fingerprint discrimination remains isolated via real browser fetches (per-value CC/ETag/CLEN gradients with B=1000 CIs) beyond degenerate loopback ceiling. Negative still requires gradient reporting to diagnose most fragile header/body magnitude.
